inventory_audit.description: Reconcile all 116 operations against the D024 presentation map, accepted Agent–Workspace outcome paths, evidence, visual findings, and design debt before remediation.

required.description: Execute the accepted Agent–Workspace outcome paths, including agnostic creation, agentic completion, direct artifact work, and full inspection, through the stable application URL and production owners.
Record every operation in its accepted primary, contextual, inspectable, automatic, secondary, or test-only presentation with completion, recovery, and exact return.
Execute primary operations with keyboard, visible focus, landmarks, browser semantics, non-color meaning, reduced motion, touch targets, and supported reflow.
Execute current, cached, running, awaiting input, proposed, applied, stale, failed, cancelled, blocked, offline, and unknown-effect recovery paths.

Run task evaluations for orientation, source verification, contradiction resolution, model use, Work management, Review, cancellation, citation tracing, writing, and recovery and close every critical finding.
Retain the final visual-regression baseline and a design-debt register with no unowned critical item.
Execute the shared shell and mechanics across scientific, controlled-writing, and unrelated Project-owned definitions without mandatory categories, shell forks, or unsafe unsupported behavior.
Use an actual certified model through Petra and Composition in the complete application, including failure and replay without authority drift.
Execute governed Project control and one registered Project-definition capability through production commands, Review or History where required, and exact return.
Apply Felicity to the complete product language, Agent onboarding, results, errors, and recovery while retaining Project-definition and authority meaning.
Run all three cumulative operation gates and the presentation-map audit with every inventory entry live, evidenced, and correctly exposed.
Challenge the final application for fake or hidden operations, client/model authority, lost work, provenance confusion, dead ends, visual incoherence, and false completion.
Run clean startup/reset, complete repository, fresh-store, actual-model, restart/replay, performance, and cumulative operation gates on clean pushed branches.
The user completes the final guided application evaluation and explicitly accepts M1; automated workers cannot satisfy this record.
